notes.contextLength: Set to match your model's maximum context. Minimum 16384 for Blackbox AI. Recommended: 32768 or higher.
notes.model: Replace with your actual loaded model name from LM Studio
notes.temperature: 0.7 is balanced. Lower (0.3-0.5) for more focused responses, higher (0.8-1.0) for more creative
notes.maxTokens: Maximum tokens in response. 4096 is good for most tasks

troubleshooting.contextLengthError: Increase contextLength to at least 16384, preferably 32768+
troubleshooting.connectionError: Ensure LM Studio server is running on port 1234
troubleshooting.slowResponses: Reduce contextLength or use a smaller model
troubleshooting.outOfMemory: Reduce GPU layers in LM Studio or use smaller model
